test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 17 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Improve the underlined part of the sentence. Choose ‘No improvement’ as an answer if the sentence is grammatically correct.**

Dr. Mark said I can **__came to his office on__** Friday or Saturday of next week.
solution:
The correct answer is **"come to his office on."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence is in the present tense, so **"can came"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The modal verb **"can"** is always followed by the base form of the verb.
 
 
• **Example**: *He can **meet**__ me.*
 
 
 
• *​*So, we have to replace **"came"** with **"come"** to make it grammatically correct.
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

**Correct sentence**: *Dr. Mark said I __**can come to his office**__ on Friday or Saturday of next week. *
